title: lifecycle-closure-receipt

sources.reason: Existing closure lifecycle and receipt implementation.

riskAssessment.reason: Closure facts must not mutate the immutable Outcome or overstate provider verification.

reasons: Persistent closure evidence and current-report semantics require Standard governance.

executionDecision.reason: The user supplied explicit lifecycle and evidence requirements.

preReviewWarnings: Do not present repository-local closure facts as Provider verification.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Task Outcome remains immutable after ai-finish and archive.
A closure receipt records the Outcome digest, PR state and SHAs, branch deletion facts, default-branch containment, closure state, provider evidence state, and timestamp.
Current Human Benefit Report distinguishes Outcome-time facts from closure-time facts and uses repository_recorded_only when Provider evidence is absent.
Missing or invalid closure receipt prevents fully_closed status.
guidelines: Keep Outcome immutable; derive closure views from verified facts only.
Do not convert local Git facts into Provider-verified evidence.

intent.problem: The archived pre-merge Outcome cannot represent later merge and branch-cleanup facts, causing current reports to display stale PR state.
constraints: Do not mutate historical Task Outcomes.
Provider evidence must remain explicitly unavailable unless provider-bound evidence exists.
intent.rationale: A separate closure receipt preserves historical truth while giving reviewers an auditable current state.

rawUserRequest: Implement WI-02 lifecycle-closure-receipt from the supplied AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instructions.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run lifecycle closure unit tests and validate generated receipt.
